class Rectangle(val width: Int, val height: Int) {
    fun area(): Int {
        if (width > 0 && height > 0) {
            return width * height
        }
        return 0
    }

    val isSquare: Boolean
        get() {
            if (width == height) {
                return true
            }
            return false
        }

    fun classify(score: Int): Int = if (score > 90) 3 else if (score > 50) 2 else 1

    fun pick(x: Int): Int {
        when (x) {
            0 -> return 10
            1 -> return 11
            2 -> return 12
            else -> return -1
        }
    }

    fun loop(n: Int): Int {
        var total = 0
        for (i in 0 until n) {
            if (i % 2 == 0 || i % 3 == 0) {
                total += i
            }
        }
        while (total > 100 && n > 0) {
            total -= n
        }
        return total
    }
}
